{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-9098.18","title":"radio.py: delayed-RX TTL is 1us equality; callback/HIL never land on expire","description":"## Problem

`_DelayedRx.expire_us` is `end_time_us + added_latency_us`. Re-inject is eligible only when `current_time_us == expire_us`:

- `_prune_delayed_rx` / `_reinject_delayed_candidates` drop when `current > expire_us`
- `_reinject_delayed_candidates` skips (keeps stash) when `current < expire_us`
- nothing is appended unless those two fail, i.e. exact equality

There is no event at `expire_us`. `EventQueue` only has `TxEndEvent` (at `end_time_us`) and `RxTimeoutEvent`. `maybe_advance_time` jumps to the next queued event. After TxEnd, that is typically the RX timeout, with `timeout_us >> expire_us`.

Callback / HIL loop (`renode_server._simulation_driver`, `node_server._simulation_driver`):

1. `deliver_pending_packets()` at T=end_time — `current < expire`, not injected
2. `maybe_advance_time()` processes RxTimeout — `RadioMixin._handle_rx_timeout` drops the stash, then time is already `timeout > expire`
3. second `deliver_pending_packets()` — node not in RX_WAIT / stash gone

REALTIME is the same: wall-clock steps skip the single eligible microsecond.

Polling tests stay green because they `advance_to(airtime + added_us)` then `get_rx_result` (`test_delayed_packet_delivers_at_expire`, `test_multihop_latency_bounds._probe_rx`). `TestDelayedRxStash` never uses `deliver_pending_packets`. `maybe_advance_time`'s claim that advancing can never skip an in-range reception is false for LatencyRule.

This is not 9098.11/15 (ghosts living forever). Those asked for TTL or drop-after-first-eligible-poll. The 11/15 fix made TTL a 1us closed point with no wake, so the production RX path never gets a first eligible poll.

## Files

- python/src/lichen/sim/simulation/radio.py (`_prune_delayed_rx`, `_reinject_delayed_candidates`, `_stash_delayed_rx_candidates`; no expire event)
- python/src/lichen/sim/simulation/event_handlers.py (`maybe_advance_time`, `advance_to`)
- python/src/lichen/sim/renode_server.py / node_server.py (deliver / advance / deliver)
- python/tests/sim/test_radio.py (`TestDelayedRxStash` polling-only)

## Why this is correctness

LatencyRule is documented as delaying delivery until `end + added`. After 11/15, that delivery is observably only if the caller already knows expire and polls at that exact us. Callback RX, BARRIER_SYNC, and REALTIME drop the frame as a TTL miss.
